LanguageData.LP_HalfOrcRelentless.label: relentless endurance
LanguageData.LP_HalfOrcRelentless.description: When taking damage that would down (but not kill) them, half-orcs grit their teeth and hold on for 12 hours: pain won't shock them into falling and consciousness won't drop below about 30%. After 12 hours the injuries resolve as usual, and if still badly hurt they fall. Triggers at most once per day; lethal damage kills as usual.
LanguageData.LP_HalfOrcRelentless.customEffectDescrip: Instead of being downed, gains 12 hours of "gritting teeth": pain cannot cause shock, consciousness floored at about 30%.
Cooldown 1 day (the health tab shows "relentless cooldown"); still downed if both legs are disabled; lethal damage is unaffected.
LanguageData.LP_HalfOrcSavage.label: savage attacks
LanguageData.LP_HalfOrcSavage.description: A half-orc's melee hits have a 10% chance to land a savage blow, dealing ×150% damage.
LanguageData.LP_HalfOrcSavage.customEffectDescription: Melee hits have a 10% chance to strike heavily: damage ×150%.
LanguageData.LP_ElfTrance.label: meditative breath
LanguageData.LP_ElfTrance.description: Elven sleep is a meditative trance. While asleep, elves with a psylink regain about 20% psyfocus each night; elves without one get no such benefit. Waking after a full 2 hours of sleep gives the "lucid meditation" mood +3 for half a day.
LanguageData.LP_ElfTrance.customEffectDescriptions.0: Psyfocus regained in sleep: about +20% per 8 hours (only with a psylink).
LanguageData.LP_ElfTrance.customEffectDescriptions.1: Waking after a full 2 hours of sleep: mood +3 for half a day.
LanguageData.LP_ElfBloodline.label: elven lineage
LanguageData.LP_ElfBloodline.description: The ancient elven bloodline makes the mind especially steadfast, resisting psychic blasts, charm, parasites and other mind effects; negative psychic moods such as psychic drone are also halved.
LanguageData.LP_ElfLongevity.label: elven longevity
LanguageData.LP_ElfLongevity.description: A slow metabolism makes elves age extremely slowly after adulthood. Before 18 they grow like everyone else; from 18 their biological age advances only 5% as fast (when others age 20 years, an elf ages 1).
LanguageData.LP_DwarfStature.label: dwarf build
LanguageData.LP_DwarfStature.description: A short, stocky build. Actual body size 80% of an ordinary person (carry capacity, caravan load and chance to be hit by ranged attacks go down accordingly), drawn at 85% size; hand hauling capacity another ×90%. +10% melee damage against trolls (the ancient feud of dwarves and trolls).
LanguageData.LP_DwarfStature.customEffectDescriptions: Actual body size: ×80% (multiplies with other body size effects).
Hauling capacity: ×90% on top of the body size reduction.
LanguageData.LP_DwarfLiver.label: drunkard's liver
LanguageData.LP_DwarfLiver.description: A dwarf's liver is tempered by a thousand hammer blows: never addicted to alcohol, hangovers halved; each drink gives the "liquid courage" mood +4 for 6 hours.
LanguageData.LP_DwarfStoneEndurance.label: stone endurance
LanguageData.LP_DwarfStoneEndurance.description: Dwarves are born in the belly of the mountain. Under a thick rock roof, mood +3, and mining speed and general labor (crafting, making, etc.) speed +10%.
LanguageData.LP_DwarfStoneEndurance.customEffectDescr: Under a thick rock roof: mood +3, mining speed ×110%, general labor speed ×110%.
